spatial_landscape.architectural_footprint: Iconic canal houses, functional modern design, polder landscapes with windmills
spatial_landscape.description: The Dutch spatial landscape is defined by its ingenuity in water management, creating a largely flat polder-land dotted with iconic windmills. Urban centers are characterized by narrow, often gabled, canal houses, reflecting centuries of trade and dense living. Modern architecture emphasizes functionality, sustainability, and innovative urban planning, contrasting with historical charm.
